name: Termini
tagline: Online zakazivanje za salone, brijačnice i stomatologe
description: Klijenti sami zakažu termin preko linka ili QR koda, bez aplikacije i poziva. Podsjetnik stiže na WhatsApp 24 i 2 sata prije, a ako klijent nema WhatsApp, šalje se SMS. Kalendar za cijeli tim, usluge, radno vrijeme i uvoz kontakata.

en.tagline: Online booking for salons, barbers and dentists
en.description: Clients book their own appointment through a link or QR code, with no app and no phone call. Reminders go out on WhatsApp 24 and 2 hours before, with SMS as a fallback for clients without WhatsApp. Team calendar, services, opening hours and contact import.

page.title: Termini — online booking with WhatsApp reminders
page.description: Clients book their own slot through a link or QR code. Reminders go out on WhatsApp 24 and 2 hours before, with SMS as fallback. Team calendar included.
page.h1: Termini — clients book themselves, reminders go to WhatsApp
body: A client opens a link or scans a QR code, sees the free slots and picks one. No app to install, no phone call, no messages back and forth.
Reminders arrive on WhatsApp 24 hours and 2 hours before the appointment. If the client has no WhatsApp, an SMS goes out instead. Built for hairdressers, dentists and anyone who works by appointment.
features: Booking through a link or QR code, with no app
WhatsApp reminders 24 and 2 hours before, SMS as fallback
Team calendar, with services and opening hours

page.title: Termini — online zakazivanje s WhatsApp podsjetnikom
page.description: Klijenti sami zakažu termin preko linka ili QR koda. Podsjetnik stiže na WhatsApp 24 i 2 sata prije, a bez WhatsAppa ide SMS. Kalendar za cijeli tim.
page.h1: Termini — klijent se zakaže sam, podsjetnik ide na WhatsApp
body: Klijent otvori link ili skenira QR kod, vidi slobodne termine i izabere svoj. Bez instaliranja aplikacije, bez poziva, bez poruka naprijed-nazad.
Podsjetnik stiže na WhatsApp 24 sata i 2 sata prije termina. Ako klijent nema WhatsApp, šalje se SMS. Napravljeno za frizere, stomatologe i sve koji rade po terminima.
features: Zakazivanje preko linka ili QR koda, bez aplikacije
WhatsApp podsjetnik 24 i 2 sata prije, SMS kao rezerva
Kalendar za cijeli tim, s uslugama i radnim vremenom
